title: Brother Marshall, family parties and the aunt's Dallas hotel
summary: His pianist brother, his mother's parties and the musicians at his aunt's hotel, including Alfonso Trent's band, make him want to be a musician.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Marshall. But he didn't play professionally. They would -- my mother used to give parties and they would have so many people that would come out, like from the city, and stay all night, you know, stay like the weekends, and I used to see all the pretty girls that would come out there, you know, and they were so popular with the girls and things and that made me want to be a musician, too. That's another thing. Oh, there are many things, along with my auntie had a hotel in Dallas, Texas, and when I'd go -- she kept all the musicians. And when I would go to Dallas, I would meet them and I just liked the way, you know, their surroundings and everything, you know. There was a band by the name of Alfonso Trent. I thought it was just like -- Jesus, they were so ahead of time, they had about 15 uniforms. They worked at the Adolphus Hotel and half of the band stayed with my auntie. I just -- you know, there were so many things around me and then I loved music, too.
